text:
Ivy Park: Quick run-through of compact compare UX — focus on badges, filters, and pin behavior before we ship density beta. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/compact-beta
Jonas Reed: uploaded a compact mock. Two issues: badge overlaps pin on narrow widths, and pin expands row which breaks visual rhythm.
Zoe Kim: keyboard note: pin gets skipped while tabbing in dense rows. we should keep a single tab stop per row by default.
Priya Singh: a11y catch: badges read as 'badge' on VO. Need aria-label like: 'Throughput 150 rps; P95 latency 11 ms; within SLO.' Visible tooltip can be short.
Marco Silva: visual shift: badges are async and push text when they load. suggest reserving fixed width (approx 80px) and showing a skeleton box.
Ivy Park: inline pinned pill seems promising — keeps height stable. maybe pill with small caret to expand details if needed.
Zoe Kim: prefer pill decorative (aria-hidden) and open details with Enter on row to avoid extra tab stops. If pill toggles, add aria-expanded.
Priya Singh: also check color contrast for status colors in compact mode. green needs to pass 4.5:1 on all themes.
Jonas Reed: i'll add CSS to reserve badge space, add skeleton, and provide an inline pill variant. will also increase pin hit area to 32px.
Marco Silva: QA: add Percy snapshot with throttled network and keyboard-only flows.
Ivy Park: timeline: Jonas shares updated frames today, Zoe will open PR tomorrow, Priya runs a11y checks after merge. tiny copy decision: tooltip -> 'P95 11ms — within SLO', aria-label keeps full sentence. thumbs? :thumbsup:
All: :thumbsup:
